This loss would push the model to distinguish between augmented views of the same sample, enhancing generalization for the primary task.  
Non-trivial crux: Designing a data-agnostic augmentation strategy and balancing the contrastive loss with the main task objective to avoid conflicting gradients, requiring dynamic weighting based on training phase and task complexity.
